state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the nightly lodging limit for a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q3: What taxi allowance applied to a daytime business taxi ride on 2026-02-15? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q4: What is the paid parental leave for a primary carer in their first year of employment today? (answer in weeks)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the monthly parking allowance for a regular employee driving to the office today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.

passages.source: HB-34 §3 | HR policy: relocation support — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: For employees relocating with dependent children, 500 EUR is added to the standard relocation lump sum. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-29 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-06-01 · superseded by: HB-34
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 2500 EUR. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR reviews the relocation lump sum once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-34 §2 | HR policy: relocation support — Standard relocation lump sum | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: Employees who relocate at the company's request receive a relocation lump sum of 3000 EUR. Questions about the relocation lump sum go to the HR, who keeps the record of decisions. Each claim for the relocation lump sum needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-55 §1 | Memo: relocation lump sum exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-05-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the relocation lump sum in HB-34. Managers confirm claims for the relocation lump sum before payment in the next payroll run. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-34 §1 | HR policy: relocation support — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-06-01 · supersedes: HB-29
passages.text: This policy sets the relocation lump sum for all employees. The HR publishes worked examples of the relocation lump sum on the intranet. Claims for the relocation lump sum are filed in the expense tool under 'HR policy: relocation support'.
